_comment: The TTCircle underwriting model. These are the same factors the Apps Script backend applies, kept here so the quotation page can show the student a live estimate before submitting. Keep both in step: if you change a factor here, change it in Code.gs too.
_insuredValueNote: Trade practice: cargo is insured at CIF value plus 10% for the buyer's expected profit and incidental costs. The premium is rated on the insured value, not on the invoice value.

CIF.note: Incoterms 2020, CIF A5: the seller must obtain cargo insurance complying with Institute Cargo Clauses (C) as a minimum. Wider cover may be agreed between the parties.

CIP.note: Incoterms 2020, CIP A5: the seller must obtain cargo insurance complying with Institute Cargo Clauses (A), all risks.

iccDescriptions.ICC(A): All risks — the broadest cover, protecting against physical loss or damage from any external cause except the listed exclusions.
iccDescriptions.ICC(B): Named perils — covers the ICC(C) list plus earthquake, lightning, washing overboard and water entering the vessel or container.
iccDescriptions.ICC(C): Basic — major casualties only: fire, explosion, sinking, stranding, overturning, collision and general average.

incotermDescriptions.EXW: Ex Works — the buyer bears all risk from the seller's premises.
incotermDescriptions.FCA: Free Carrier — risk transfers when the goods are handed to the carrier.
incotermDescriptions.FAS: Free Alongside Ship — risk transfers alongside the vessel.
incotermDescriptions.FOB: Free On Board — risk transfers once the goods are on board.
incotermDescriptions.CPT: Carriage Paid To — the seller pays the freight, the buyer bears the risk.
incotermDescriptions.CIP: Carriage and Insurance Paid To — the seller insures at ICC(A).
incotermDescriptions.CFR: Cost and Freight — the seller pays the freight but does not insure.
incotermDescriptions.CIF: Cost, Insurance and Freight — the seller insures at ICC(B) minimum.
incotermDescriptions.DAP: Delivered At Place — the seller bears the risk until delivery.
incotermDescriptions.DPU: Delivered at Place Unloaded — risk transfers after unloading.
incotermDescriptions.DDP: Delivered Duty Paid — the seller bears the maximum responsibility.
